_comment: MERGE the `hooks` and `env` blocks below into .claude/settings.json (or
settings.local.json) BY HAND. This file is inert where it sits.
core   N1 N2 P S  'is this number real'   measured 4% of replies blocked
normal + I V      'and is it legible'     measured 14%
strict + N3       'and is it labelled'    requires trust/provenance.py adoption first
TRUST_OFF=1 in the shell environment also disables everything. That switch is
Andy's; the assistant has no in-band override, deliberately.
Interpreter: `python3` is used below because both hooks are stdlib-only.
Timeout 20s is ample -- measured 0.93s on a 113 MB transcript.
